title: Brilliant Retort
summary: Throw up to 60 ft as an Action. The pinned source reports two 3d4 + 9 Force damage instances in about a 13 ft radius. The bomb can also Silence for 2 turns.

fields.Throw: Action. Throw up to 60 ft. In about a 13 ft radius deal 3d4 + 9 Force and inflict Silenced for 2 turns. DC 12 Dexterity halves the damage and prevents Silence. Objects and scenery are automatically critically hit.
fields.Reported game behavior: The pinned source reports a second 3d4 + 9 Force damage instance when thrown or destroyed, for a typical total of 6d4 + 18 Force. Attacks with multiple damage sources can trigger additional instances when destroying the bomb.
fields.Acquisition: Unique reward from Barcus Wroot for rescuing Wulbren. Unavailable through vendors or Alchemy.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and pinned evidence, then refined its mechanics against item and linked rule notes.
